This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant who is in jail since 27.3.2024 in connection with Crime No.110/2024, registered at Police Station Kirnapur,

opennyai_summary.15_May_2024__decision:

In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

5. Applicant does not have any other criminal antecedent.
Offence is punishable upto 7 years of imprisonment.
Applicant is ready to deposit Rs.2,25,000/- before the trial court.
6. In view of same, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on condition that:-
(i) Applicant will deposit an amount of Rs.2,25,000/- (Two Lakhs Twenty Five Thousand Only) before the trial court.
Said amount be kept in FDR with instructions to Bank to renew the FDR periodically till conclusion of trial.
(ii) Amount of Rs.2,25,000/- deposited by the applicant before the trial court shall be subject to final judgment to be passed by the trial court.
7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial on aforesaid conditions.
8. The applicant shall also abide by the following conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. as under:-
(a) that such person shall attend in accordance with the conditions of the bond executed under this Chapter;
(b) that such person shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected of the commission of which he is suspected and;
(c) that such person shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
It is the submission of counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 18.12.2023 and suffered almost ten months' incarceration, whereas charge sheet has already been filed.
Matter pertains to documentary evidence.
It is further submitted that the applicant was taken by Sohanlal to complete certain formalities at Court and therefore he was swayed by the persuasion of Sohanlal and he did not know the implication.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Looking to the nature of allegation, applicant can not temper with the evidence.
This fact is strengthened by the fact that the applicant does not bear any criminal record and this was his first tryst with legal proceedings, therefore, he was unaware.
He undertakes to abide by all the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court and would not try to temper with the evidence.

rpc_texts: Looking to the period of custody and nature of offence, his case may be considered for bail.
